title: WorldSaver
description: This mod adds automatic backupping of your world, so you'll never loose a world again. (at the moment it only supports local backup) Its recommended to use mod menu with this mod for better configurability.
body:
This mod adds automatic backupping of your world, into a folder in your saves folder, so you'll never loose a world again. (at the moment it only supports local backup) 

Its recommended to use mod menu with this mod for better configurability.
World worlds are backed up as zip files to take up as little storage space as possible.
